thread:
Maya: Quick AM handoff. I'm passing the bridge to Liam (primary) and Kevin (secondary). One active incident for elevated API latency. Leaving this thread with checks for PagerDuty, AWS assume-role, and Grafana access. I'll hang around for 12m in case any handoff pain.
pagerduty-bot: [AUTO] On-call change scheduled: Maya -> Liam in 12m. Open incidents: 1 (P1) - realtime Core API latency. Escalation policy: realtime-core.
devops-bot: Recent deploys: none in last 45m. No builds in progress. :white_check_mark:
Sam: @Maya copying the checklist. Do we need to rotate PD API tokens or just role membership checks?
Maya: @Sam, for this passoff we only need role membership and that you can add responders and trigger the escalation policy. PD checklist (CLI/web):

```
# verify PD identity and team membership
pd api get /users/me
# web: PagerDuty -> Configuration -> Users -> search
```

Maya: Liam/Kevin, please confirm:
- you can see the live incident in PD
- you can escalate via the realtime-core policy
- you can add responders
- you can view the prod-api Grafana dashboard and mute/unmute alerts if needed

Liam: I see the PD incident, escalation works, and I can add responders. Grafana: view+panel access only, not org settings. I can open the alert and mute for 15m.

Kevin: PD: I can view incident but escalate returns "permission denied". Grafana: I can view dashboards. AWS: I tried to assume the oncall role and STS denied me.

Maya: OK Kevin needs two changes. Actions:
1) PagerDuty: add Kevin to the "Escalators"/realtime-ops group so escalate action succeeds.
2) AWS: add Kevin to the trust policy for the RedwoodOncallRole or add him to a group allowed to assume-role. Quick test commands:

```
aws sts get-caller-identity
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodOncallRole --role-session-name kevin-test
```

Maya: If assume-role gives AccessDenied, please ping infra-admins or file a no-blocker ticket. Minimal trust policy snippet for infra-admins:

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/kevin" },
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
    }
  ]
}
```

Sam: Who on infra-admins can do this immediately if @devops-lead is unavailable?
devops-lead: I'm around, will update trust policy in ~8m and leave an audit note. Will also drop a short-lived session for Kevin if needed.

Kevin: PD escalate fixed by @Emily 97 she added me to Escalators. Trying assume-role again when trust is live.

ops-bot: Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/realtime-core. Summary:
- immediate: scale inference pool (runbook step 2)
- diag: check per-model latency, KV cache hit rates, queue depth
- fallback: route requests to quantized/cheaper model variant if scaling doesn't reduce latency

Maya: Runbook quick ops snippets for convenience:

```
# scale GPU pool via infra CLI
infra scale gpu --cluster realtime --delta 2

# queue snapshot
curl -s https://ops-api.internal/queues | jq '.models[] | {name, depth, p50, p95}'

# trigger routing fallback
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/route/fallback -d '{"from":"gpt-xl","to":"gpt-xl-quant"}'
```

Liam: Copy. Kevin, once you can assume-role, run the queue snapshot and post p95 for top 3 models. I'll handle bridge and customer comms. If infra-level escalation needed, tag Sam and I'll page SRE.

Kevin: assume-role succeeded. Queue p95: gpt-embed-2 = 460ms, inference-batch = 920ms, api-gateway = 1.02s. Polling every 90s and will post changes.

Maya: Good data. Notes for handoff summary (to log in JIRA):
- Primary: Liam (bridge lead + PD actions)
- Secondary: Kevin (runbook executor + AWS ops)
- Tertiary: Sam (infra escalation)
- Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/realtime-core
- Grafana dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/prod/prod-api
- PD oncall policy: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/oncalls

Maya: Grafana mute/unmute perms: need Editor role at prod org to mute alerts; Reader cannot. If you cannot mute alerts, ask devops or grafana-admin for temporary Edit access.

Kevin: I can mute/unmute. Plan: if overall API p95 > 1s for two consecutive samples, I will scale + consider fallback routing.

Liam: I'll own customer comms. Suggested template: "We're investigating increased API latency impacting generation calls. Engineers are mitigating. Next update in 15 minutes." Use channel #customer-notify and the template pinned there.

Maya: Handing off now. Please confirm by posting "handoff complete" once PD and AWS checks are green.

Liam: Handoff complete 97 confirmed PD escalate and Grafana access. Taking bridge.

Kevin: Handoff complete 97 assume-role is working and I can run runbook steps. Monitoring.

Sam: Acknowledged. Standing by for infra escalation if needed. :eyes:

Maya: Logging handoff in JIRA: ONCALL-1730. Signing off. :wave:

pagerduty-bot: [AUTO] On-call rotation applied: primary -> Liam, secondary -> Kevin. Time: 07:28 UTC.
